ADM-004.frontend_impact: applyVoidSubmission returns unknown for every RPC error except ADMIN_REQUIRED → pending lock + Retry loop for a request that can never succeed.

ADM-006.frontend_impact: session.signOut clears player pendings only; seven star-princess.admin.* localStorage keys persist for the next admin on the same browser (source contract).

ADM-007.frontend_impact: Router redirects enabledGames.length===0 to /unavailable before requiresAdmin → /admin unreachable (source contract).

defects.title: Server accepts non-enum tier at stage; publish then fails with a raw RPC error and no ledger row
defects.observed: stage ok=true; publish error="invalid input value for enum cocktail_bounty_tier: "bogus_tier""; admin_find_catalog_publish_request_by_id(request) → null (no ledger row)
defects.impact: Frontend publishImport maps any RPC error to status "unknown" and Check Status finds no ledger → operator is stuck on an unknown that can never resolve (same lock family as ADM-008). Only reachable by bypassing the TS validator, but TS/SQL validators diverge.

publish.error: invalid input value for enum cocktail_bounty_tier: "bogus_tier"

defects.title: Catalog stage/publish accepts Cocktail candidates designated at the virtual mobile-order bar (CAT-002 reaches live slots)
defects.observed: 4 active bounty offers now designate mobile-order; client TS preview ready=true; server stage ok=true
defects.impact: A bounty whose designated bar is the virtual Mobile Order source cannot be completed at a physical bar and MO logs are excluded → unfulfillable/ confusing live bounty. DB exclusion only protects eligibility, not scheduling.

defects.title: Set Ship Time past the finale irreversibly latches games; backend gives no refusal/confirmation (UI guard only)
